intro.subtitle: Let's set things up in under a minute.

step1.title: How did you hear about Stack32?
step1.subtitle: Please answer honestly — it helps us know which channels actually work.

step2.title: What best describes you?
step2.subtitle: Pick the closest match. We'll tailor Stack32 to your workflow.

step3.title: Tell us a bit about you
step3.subtitle: Your first name, a public username, and optionally how you plan to use Stack32.
step3.usernameHint: Public agent links look like stack32.com/@username/agent-name. Choose carefully — this is how people find your agents.
step3.usernameInvalid: Use 3–30 characters: start with a letter, then letters, numbers, or underscores.
step3.phoneHint: Optional — choose your country code, then enter your number without the leading 0.
step3.useCase: What will your first agent do? (optional)
step3.useCasePlaceholder: e.g. Research prospects for my agency

username.settingsBody: A username is required to publish agents and share public links.

step4.title: Create your first workspace
step4.subtitle: A workspace groups your agents. You can create more later and switch between them anytime.
step4.point1: Keep personal and client projects separate
step4.point2: Each workspace has its own list of agents
step4.point3: Switch workspaces anytime from the sidebar
